about: The scripted default-length autorun that must reach the Hollow Warden (pull 4, the boss pull, pull index 3) and end on run_end. No --ticks: BOSS-AUTORUN (game/src/Host/SimDriver.cs ArenaOptions.UntilRunEnd) runs until the first run_end, capped at ceilingTicks. The Warden is driven by ScriptedWarden (game/src/Host/ScriptedWarden.cs); SimDriver reads no input file. BossAutorunSceneTest.ps1 reads 'run' and 'expect' and checks the demo.log fail-closed.
